system.description:
Vale sits holding her fallen ally in her arms. As the enemy surrounds her. “This is it, Uchiha. It’s over, there is no way to reconcile what you did. If you had just surrendered from the beginning, they would all be alive” the rogue shinobi says while placing his weapon on his shoulder looking down on her. Vale begins to look up at them, but something is different. Her eyes are red with additional tome in them. The rogue shinobi attack her but misses, she moves like she was a phantom, a ghost. She sees all of their movements before they even make them and will get vengeance for her fallen allies. She feels her weakness being the sole reason for their defeat and she will rectify it, if it's the last thing she does.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 15 excerpt.

The Curse of Hatred

The Uchiha clan is one of the four noble clans of Konohagakure, reputed to be one of the village's strongest because of their Sharingan and natural battle prowess. After helping found Konoha decades ago, the Uchiha grew increasingly isolated from the village's affairs, culminating in most of their deaths during the Uchiha clan downfall. After the 4th great ninja war, they began to find footing and regrow. There are quite a few Uchiha now in the present day, though not as many who are shinobi.

Uchiha Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex or Int, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Pick one between: Ninshou, Martial Arts, Illusions

Fire Release Affinity: You have Fire Release affinity.

Uchiha Techniques: The Uchiha Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Uchiha Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Uchiha Features

Advanced Adaptation

1st Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are known for their extreme adaptation on the battlefield. Able to see, comprehend, understand and react all in a hair’s breadth with or without a Sharingan. You can select 2 of the following adaptations. You can select another adaptation at 7th and 15th levels.

Amplified Defense

You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.

Amplified Flames

Uchiha hare often hailed as the Fire release specialists of the Land of Fire. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, that affects an area you can increase the size of the area by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th.

Amplified Retaliation

The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Agile Fist

The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.

You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage

When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.

As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.

Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.

Shurikenjutsu

The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Sharingan

3rd Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the Hidden Leaf Village’s 2 great dojutsu. The Sharingan is an eye of extreme potential and flexibility. You gain access to the Sharingan. When you enter initiative, you can activate your Sharingan which lasts until the end of combat. Your Sharingan grants some passive bonuses, but you also has evolutions that can elevate it into a tool that represents you. Alternatively, you can activate your Sharingan as a bonus action and remains active for 1 minute.

You begin with 1 Ocular Evolution which you can use while your Sharingan is active. You can use these abilities by spending Ocular Charges. You have a number of Ocular Charges equal to 1+ your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Ocular Evolutions at 7th, 11th and 15th levels. You regain all spent Ocular Charges when you complete a rest.

| #### Sharingan / Reflex Amp / Your Sharingan grants you the following bonuses; / Chakra Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Chakra Sight. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level. / Enemy Reading. You gain a rank of mastery to the following skill-based action; See Through Lies, Sense Motive, and Search. You can also use the aforementioned skill-actions as a bonus action. / Eye of Insight. When you take the Read the Enemy skill action, you gain a +4 bonus to the check. |

Sharingan Dodge

You can perceive an attacks target before it would ever land. Once per turn, while you are not grappled or prone, when you take damage from an attack or make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, you can spend 2 Ocular Charges to gain a rank of mastery to your AC or saving throw until the start of your next turn. This bonus does not stack with itself. When you reach 7th level, you instead gain 2 ranks of mastery.

Beginning at 15th level, you can choose to instead spend 3 Ocular Charges to cause the triggering attack to miss or automatically succeed the triggering saving throw.

Rewrite History

You place your allies under a helpful visual spell. As a reaction to an allied creature failing a saving throw, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge, allowing them to reroll. If they still fail, you can spend 2 additional Ocular Charges to make them remake their saving throw again. If they fail still, you can spend +1 additional Ocular Charge forcing them to remake the saving throw.

Hypnotic Eye

Your Sharingan can impart minor illusions onto enemies. As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Ocular Charges you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that isn’t blind, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save they become either Berserk, Charmed, or Confused for the next minute. An affected creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success. On a success the target creature gains immunity to this evolution for the next 10 minutes.

Ocular Jutsu Augmentation

Your Sharingan grants you some inherent knowledge of how to better manipulate jutsu you cast. By spending 2 Ocular Charge as part of casting a Jutsu, you cast it without the Hand Sign (HS) or Chakra Molding (CM) components.

Sharingan Copy

The Sharingan is known as the copy wheel eye, capable of reading, translating and imprinting the process of how to use a jutsu or ability it saw onto your brain.

As a reaction to a creature, you can see casting a Jutsu with either the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components, but doesn’t have the Hijutsu keyword, you can spend 3 Ocular Charges to imprint the jutsu cast into your mind. The imprinted jutsu must be no more than the highest rank jutsu known based on your level. If you imprint a jutsu that has a nature release that you do not have an affinity for, increase that jutsu’s cost by an amount based on its rank. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +6, B-Rank: +8, A-Rank: +10, S-Rank: +12).

This jutsu is added to a special list known as your Imprint List. Your Imprint List is similar to your known jutsu list in which you can cast jutsu from it as if it’s on your known jutsu list, but with some specific rules.

You cannot cast jutsu on your Imprint List unless your Sharingan is active.

You can have 2 imprinted jutsu on your Imprint List. This increases to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.

Sharingan: Genjutsu!

The Sharingan is a weapon so potent that enemies know to never look you in the eye, else you place a spell upon them.

When you gain this Evolution and when you complete a rest of any type, select 2 Genjutsu you qualify for, of a rank you can cast based on your level, that has a casting time of 1 Action or Bonus Action. The chosen jutsu become known as Memorized Illusions, which are imprinted upon your Sharingan. You can imprint the same Memorized Illusion twice. Each imprint is treated as its own slot. Once you cast a Memorized Illusion it is spent and is no longer imprinted until you complete a short or long rest.

As an Action on your turn, you can activate this evolution, spending 2 Ocular Charges to cast one of the imprinted jutsu from your Sharingan. The jutsu’s range becomes 30 feet and you must be able to maintain eye contact with them for its casting. Casting this jutsu does not reveal your location or break stealth.

Increase the number of Memorized Illusions you can have by +1 when you reach 7th and 11th level.

Genjutsu Counter

Your Sharingan grants you some inherent awareness of Genjutsu and even the ability to dispel them. Genjutsu, whose DC is equal to or less than your passive Illusion skill or your Genjutsu Save DC (Whichever is higher) are those that you become aware of. Genjutsu you are aware of radiate a misty haze. If a creature is under the effect of a Genjutsu you are aware of the radiate this haze. By spending a Bonus action, you can perform the Identify Genjutsu skill action on a Genjutsu you are aware of.

As an Action by spending 1 Ocular Charge or bonus action by spending 2 Ocular Charges, while you an allied or willing creature is under the effects of a Genjutsu, you can make an Ability check using your highest jutsu ability modifier, vs the DC of the Genjutsu affecting the target. On a success, you Dispel the afflicting Genjutsu.

If you are aware of the Genjutsu, you can instead make an Illusions check in place of an ability check.

Blood of the Fan

7th Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are well known in many shinobi circles as having stern, cool, and commanding presences. Their proximity to other capable shinobi makes it difficult to take control of a situation while an Uchiha is present.

When a non-allied creature attempts to make an Intimidation or Persuasion check against another creature while you are present, you can spend a reaction and impose disadvantage on their check. Once you use this feature you cannot do so again for 10 minutes or you succeed an Intimidation check, recharging it.

Fanning The Flame

11th Level Clan Feature

Uchiha’s affinity to fire release isn’t just associated with offensive fire release, but in how they move, fight and counter. Their passion burns bright, igniting the embers of ambition in all others. When you activate your Sharingan, you can select 2 of the listed abilities, gaining them for the duration of this combat. You can use your selected abilities, once per turn. You cannot use more than one of these abilities as part of the same trigger;

Blazing Set Up. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with an attack or jutsu you cast of B-Rank or lower, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your Bonus action to mark all affected creatures until the end of your next turn. The next time a marked creature takes damage from yourself or one of your allies that you can see, you can detonate the mark, dealing 3d6 fire damage to the marked creature.

After-Image Assault. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your reaction to force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, until the start of your next turn, attacks against you from the affected creature is at disadvantage. If the affected creature deals damage to you through this effect, you can choose to select a space within 10 feet of yourself, and teleport to that space as you try to create distance between yourself and the enemy.

Ricochet Technique. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or 1 Bonus action to select a second creature within 20-feet of the original target. Remake your attack roll, targeting the second creature. On a hit, you deal half damage to the second target but apply the original attacks effects to the second target as well.

Critical Refocus. Once per turn, when a creature critically fails their saving throw resisting a Genjutsu you cast, you regain 1 Ocular Charge, per creature that critically failed.

Commanding Gaze. Once per turn, in place of an attack granted by the Attack action, you can gaze into the eyes of a non-blinded enemy you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge and they make a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, you can imprint one of the following subconscious commands into them. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Command, Disarm. The affected creature, at the beginning or end of their turn, your choice, throws their weapon 30 + 5 times their strength of dexterity modifier in feet away from themselves in a direct of your choice.

Command, Retarget. When the affected creature targets a creature it can see, it must target a different creature it can see, even if that creature is its own ally.

Command, Telegraph. The affected creature telegraphs their next attack or jutsu unconsciously yelling out its name and its effects and who they are targeting and why. You and all allied creatures that can see and hear them gains the benefit of a successful Read the Enemy.

Command, Taunt. The affected creature gains disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than yourself. Additionally, creatures other than yourself treat the affected creatures save DC as -2 lower unless you are part of the area of effect or making the same saving throw from the same effect.

Crimson Sovereign

15th Level Clan Feature

You foresee victory in the movements of your enemies, even without the Sharingan.

As a bonus action, you can initiate your Crimson Aura, radiating a pulsing aura of chakra, radiating outwards from you in a 20-foot radius, centered on you. You can maintain this Crimson Aura for 1 minute, after which you cannot activate your aura until you complete a long rest.

While your aura is active you gain the following benefits;

Exploit Opening. Creatures that make attacks while in your aura, triggers attacks of opportunities from you. The first attack of opportunity you make against a creature, per round doesn’t consume your reaction.

Scan the Perimeter. Creatures that begin or end their turn within this radius, reveal themselves to you. You become aware of one statistic from a hostile creature between their AC, one saving throw bonus of your choice, or one special ability, attack or trait the creature has, that is unique to it.

Redirection. Once per turn, when a hostile creature you can see declares an attack against you while another hostile creature is within your aura, you can spend your reaction to force another hostile creature within your aura to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being forced to interpose the attack on a failed save.
